authority: Creates retrieval candidates only; XTDB and KurrentDB remain authoritative and an embedding artifact declaration is not a qualified embedding model.
failure_or_lesson: Checking only the current version ID still allowed invented source IDs in a derived vector payload. Read-time authority reconciliation must include the exact persisted evidence relations.
goal: Add the selected vector plane as a derived candidate index without letting stale or forged points become memory authority.
notes: This seed teaches an indexing method and a negative check, not a vector model or a semantic retrieval result.
procedure: Partition collections by host scope and embedding generation; index only the current claim after exact raw/event evidence verification; keep only IDs and generation metadata in Qdrant; at query time compare each candidate to XTDB current projection, version, and evidence relations before returning a source reference.
validation: Real Qdrant 1.18.3, XTDB 2.1.0, and KurrentDB integration run 36571301770 passed. A synthetic correction leaves the older vector in the index but rejects it at read time; a forged source list is also rejected.
